verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows generic API/webhook/SDK references (e.g., a 'featurebase-js' client SDK, webhooks, security/signature verification) but nothing explicitly describes identifying logged-in users or tying feedback submissions to existing user accounts (e.g., JWT/SSO identity verification). Missing for 10: explicit docs on user identity verification/SSO for feedback submission, API fields for user ID/email linking, and any hands-on confirmation of this tying mechanism.
